FAQ

Before you call.

Do you offer fixed-fee planning?

Yes. Estate plans, entity formations, and contract reviews can often be scoped before work begins.

Can you take urgent litigation matters?

We reserve capacity for injunctions and emergency business disputes when conflicts clear.

Where do you meet clients?

We meet in Philadelphia, West Chester, and by secure video conference.
